item.title: Lawmakers propose $175 million for Lake Champlain through 2032
item.description: New York lawmakers from both parties have introduced a federal bill to extend the Lake Champlain Basin Program through 2032, earmarking $35 million a year for water quality improvements, invasive species control, and pollution reduction across the border with Vermont.

item.title: Home care workers, lawmakers want transparency on $11B CDPAP operator PPL
item.description: New York lawmakers and advocates are pushing for transparency from Public Partnerships LLC, the company running the state's Medicaid home care system, after 150,000 workers and 90,000 patients left the program due to missing paychecks and benefits.
